global_style: A modern, sophisticated presentation template utilizing a muted Morandi color palette, soft geometric shapes, and clean grid layouts.

identity_anchors: Large, overlapping, heavily rounded shapes anchored to the bottom edge on cover/section slides.
Pill-shaped (capsule) section indicators positioned at the top left of content slides.
Large, thin, uppercase background typography acting as a watermark beneath primary titles.
Alternating solid color blocks and images used in tight checkerboard or grid formations.

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
